summary: The 11.5-minute record contains 9 completed experiments, all compute-bound. Its three leading durations total 7.79 minutes, but no data available this milestone assigns that cost to an internal phase; the locked classification records no confirmed GPU idleness during compute-bound tasks.
bottlenecks_identified: Runtime was concentrated in the three slowest experiments, which account for 7.79 of 11.5 minutes; Recompute frozen Ising evidence with explicit support accounting led at 3.27 minutes.
Disk-mtime reconstruction provides no per-phase spans, so no data available this milestone explains why the duration leaders were slow.
The GPU report is a point-in-time process snapshot rather than experiment-window telemetry, so sustained GPU efficiency cannot be established from it.
No model-count or runner-dispatch receipt is available; no data available this milestone establishes that a task with two or more models failed to engage DualGPURunner.
improvements_suggested: Emit one experiment execution receipt that joins phase spans, process identity, model count, selected runner, and device assignment.
Sample GPU utilization and memory throughout each compute-bound experiment, keyed to experiment start and finish, instead of relying on a closing snapshot.
Add queue-aware placement that can send separate eligible single-model experiments to separate GPUs while reserving DualGPURunner for tasks that actually load two or more models in parallel.
Use the joined receipts to report phase-level critical paths and measured scheduler counterfactuals before assigning a nonzero savings estimate.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Create task-correlated execution receipts with phase, process, model-count, runner, and device fields.
Add continuous per-experiment GPU sampling so compute-window efficiency is directly measurable.
Schedule independent eligible single-model experiments across both GPUs, without enforcing DualGPURunner on single-model work.
meta_reflection: This evidence is adequate for ordering elapsed costs, not for diagnosing them or grading accelerator efficiency. The savings forecast stays at zero until an execution-aligned trace can support a measured comparison.
